newsitem.title: USA: Keystone to buy First Financial.
newsitem.headline: Keystone to buy First Financial.

text.p: Keystone Financial Inc said on Tuesday that it agreed to acquire First Financial Corp of Western Maryland, a thrift holding company based in Cumberland, Maryland.
First Financial has about $345 million in assets and 10 community offices in Allegany, Garrett and Washington counties, Maryland.

Under the agreement, each shareholder of First Financial will receive common stock at a fixed exchange rate of 1.29 shares of Keystone for each First Financial share, or an equivalent amount of cash, Keystone said.

Keystone said the the stock issuance will amount to 55 percent to 60 percent of the total consideration, which values First Financial at $34.19 a share, or $74 million based on Keystone's November 25 closing share price of $26.50 a share.
In connection with the agreement, First Financial gave Keystone an option to purchase 19.9 percent of its outstanding common stock under certain circumstances.
First Financial's banking operations will be combined with those of American Trust Bank NA, Keystone said.
The agreement is subject to approval by regulatory agencies and shareholders of First Financial, Keystone said.
Completion of the acquisition is expected during the first half of 1997, Keystone said.
